| **Summary** | Publisher-wide Elsevier policy (no Applied-Ergonomics-specific override found). Authors MAY use generative AI/AI-assisted tools only to improve language/readability, with human review of all output; AI tools must not be listed as author/co-author; use must be disclosed in a 'Declaration of Generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the writing process' section. Reviewers/editors are NOT permitted to upload manuscripts into generative AI tools during peer review (confidentiality). Rated leniency 3 (permitted for language-polish only, not content generation) with a disclosure gate. |

### AI-Research Notes (sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- https://muchong.com/html/201601/9920839.html
- https://muchong.com/html/201708/5459540.html
- https://muchong.com/html/202005/14229390.html
- https://scirev.org/journal/applied-ergonomics/
- https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/the-use-of-generative-ai-and-ai-assisted-technologies-in-writing-for-elsevier
- https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/applied-ergonomics

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **peer_review type verification**: Elsevier/journal guide-for-authors page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch; single-blind claim comes only from a third-party summary site (Editage), not the primary Elsevier guide-for-authors page, so confidence is moderate not high.
- **preprint.allowed (journal-specific)**: No Applied-Ergonomics-specific preprint clause was found; only Elsevier's generic cross-journal sharing policy exists, and the guide-for-authors page (where it would be confirmed) was blocked with 403, so left null rather than assumed identical to Elsevier's generic default.
- **experiential.review_time_months**: SciRev page for Applied Ergonomics explicitly states zero reviews submitted ('No reviews have yet been submitted for this journal') -- no first-hand quantitative data exists there. A third-party aggregator (academic-accelerator.com) claims 360 days but this is a scraped/derivative number with unclear methodology, not a first-hand author report, so excluded as filler rather than reported as fact.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No source (SciRev, muchong, reddit) reported a desk-reject percentage for this journal.
- **experiential.acceptance_note**: muchong threads show inconsistent anecdotal timelines (one case 7+ months still 'under review'; one thread simply announces acceptance with no extractable detail; one is an unresolved question thread) -- no consistent acceptance pattern could be extracted as verified fact.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No concrete, attributable first-hand description of reviewer culture was found on muchong, zhihu, fabiaoji, or Reddit r/AskAcademia for this specific journal; only a vague third-party paraphrase ('high acceptance difficulty') without a directly quotable source thread.
- **positioning.accepts_now / framing_required**: No 2024-2026 recent-article-title sample or active CFP/special-issue was retrieved in this session; searches returned only generic scope/metrics pages, not a dated title list -- would require a further ScienceDirect recent-articles crawl not completed here.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- 小木虫 muchong.com: 3 threads found (202005/14229390 - complaint about 7-month stuck review; 201708/5459540 - question thread, no resolution content retrievable; 201601/9920839 - acceptance announcement thread, but fetch did not yield extractable timeline/round details) -- partial signal only, no clean quantitative facts
- fabiaoji: 0 results found in searches performed
- 知乎 zhihu: 0 results found in searches performed
- Reddit r/AskAcademia: 0 results found -- search returned only generic journal-metrics pages, no Reddit threads
- SciRev: page exists but explicitly states 0 reviews submitted for this journal -- honest null result
